subject: CoHo Student Housing Expansion Projects
overview: Tufts University presented plans to replace two existing properties with new student dormitories to increase housing capacity for upperclassmen. Officials discussed sustainability goals, architectural designs, and management strategies to address neighborhood concerns regarding parking and noise.

items.title: Projects Introduction
items.summary: Rocco DiRico introduced plans to develop student housing at 50 Winthrop and 24 Capen Street as part of the university's 'COHO' program for juniors and seniors.

items.title: Sustainability Initiatives
items.summary: Ruthie Bennett described energy efficiency standards and decarbonization efforts, including the use of super-insulated prefabricated panels, triple-pane windows, and drought-resistant landscaping.

items.title: Site Design and Accessibility
items.summary: Architect Jerry Frank presented the proposed replacement structures, detailing the structural deficiencies of current buildings and the shift to ADA-compliant units providing 21 and 28 student beds respectively.

items.title: Project Timeline
items.summary: The development schedule includes demolition applications to the Historical Commission in June 2022 and site plan reviews in the fall, with targeted project completion by August 2023.

items.title: Community Q&A
items.summary: Representatives addressed neighborhood concerns regarding student parking restrictions, noise enforcement, zoning compliance for dormitories, and private trash collection services.
